name: Borderline sound board
drawing: Sound Board Assembly 834-0055 Rev. A, sheets 6 and 7 of 7, in the Borderline manual (doc 7756fbdad1fb, pp. 26-27) -- via MAME's netlist
revision: Borderline sound board 834-0055 Rev. A: gun, jeep, point, hit, animal, 'emar', walk and cry sounds from 555s, 74123s, LM324s and MB4391 VCAs, mixed through eight volume pots.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist and compared with both sheets, up to the mixer's output capacitor C76 and edge pin 4. The sound latch on the logic board is ports.
